versions.changelog: v2.10.0: Add Template #17 WeChat Official Account, expand 2026 AI fatigue word lists (EN+CN 18 each), add 3 new end-to-end examples (style cloning+SEO, instant mode, long-form)

v2.9.2: Security & Privacy Hardening - Added PRIVACY.md, consent gates for web research and style cloning, data minimization for sub-agents, narrowed instant mode triggers, fixed nationality-based classification, privacy notices throughout all phases
v2.9.1 protocol reliability patch: session-state contract, adaptive 100-point Reader scoring, Executor constraint warnings, Evolution attribution fixes

SEO module: keyword extraction, intent classification, title scoring, density presets, readability targets, internal linking strategy. New Phase 1.6 + Phase 3 checklist. Template support expanded from 2 to 5.

**v2.8 introduces advanced style cloning and long-form chapter management for next-level personalized and large-scale writing.**

- Added the Style Cloning Engine: extracts 8-dimensional writing fingerprints from user samples for "write like me" output, with MEMORY.md integration and drift adaptation.
- Introduced Long-Form Chapter Manager: supports thesis/book-length projects with per-chapter workflow, consistency checks, and progress tracking.
- Included template #16 for “开题报告” and expanded coverage to 16 templates.
- Enhanced Instant Mode’s Creator review with a 5-point “AI-ness” hard check, including passive voice and forced conclusions.
- Added cold-start onboarding: if no history, Creator asks for user dislikes and reference articles.
- Improved documentation: added guides for style cloning, instant mode, and long-form protocols.
Instant Mode, dual-temp writing, template fatigue word lists, word count soft band

v2.3.0: bilingual detection, examples, English README
v2.2.0: template library 11 to 15 -- added thesis, resume, moments post, product review. Also fixed existing templates.

**v2.1.0 — Triadic Writing Skill**

- Introduced self-evolving "Evolution Engine": After each writing session, corrections and user feedback are instantly distilled into a structured, ever-growing style memory (MEMORY.md), improving personalization over time.
- Major upgrade of MEMORY.md: Now a type-tagged, multi-dimensional style log covering preferences, banned/whitelisted phrases, correction history, and template usage analytics.
- Creator now always reads MEMORY.md before each session and deeply integrates user’s style history into every stage, from questioning to rules output.
- Added references/evolution-analyst-prompt.md to define the Evolution Engine's prompt and update logic.
- Improved documentation (README.md, CHANGELOG.md) and updated protocol/config references to reflect the evolution/learning workflow.

Writing-Triadic 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a triadic collaborative writing framework with three roles: Creator (Content Architect), Executor (Precision Writer), and Reader (Audience Persona) for high-quality, user-intent-driven writing.
- Supports article, blog, essay, copywriting, technical documentation, fiction, or any creative text generation—especially useful when ideas are vague and require clarification.
- Implements structured multi-phase workflow: user intent mining (max 4 questions per round), template matching, web research, multi-version drafting, weighted multi-dimensional review, and iterative feedback.
- Defines detailed workspace setup, file organization, and memory/knowledge base management to ensure persistent learning and adaptability.
- Includes automated web research for up-to-date templates, techniques, and industry cases, with explicit skip conditions for privacy or user preference.
- Embeds safeguards to avoid generic AI outputs and maintain authentic, audience-focused writing quality.
